Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.port.outbound

Interface TransactionalEmailPort

All Known Implementing Classes:
TransactionalEmailAdapter
public interface TransactionalEmailPort
Outbound port for sending transactional emails (welcome, expiration, etc.).

Unlike newsletter delivery which sends bulk emails via NewsletterDeliveryPort, this port handles individual one-off transactional messages triggered by user actions or system events.
